WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT timestamp, value
  FROM process_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND station_name = 'ced_station'
    AND metric_name = 'entry_stopper_lowering_time'
),
 
baseline AS (
  SELECT mean, std_dev
  FROM baseline_metrics
  WHERE station_name = 'ced_station'
    AND metric_name = 'entry_stopper_lowering_time'
  LIMIT 1
)
 
SELECT
  f.timestamp AS time,
  f.value AS "value",
 
  (b.mean + 3 * b.std_dev) AS "UCL (+3σ)",
  (b.mean - 3 * b.std_dev) AS "LCL (-3σ)",
  b.mean AS "Mean",
 
  CASE
    WHEN f.value > (b.mean + 3 * b.std_dev)
      OR f.value < (b.mean - 3 * b.std_dev)
    THEN f.value
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "Anomaly"
 
FROM filtered f
CROSS JOIN baseline b
ORDER BY f.timestamp;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    value
  FROM process_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND station_name = 'ced_station'
    AND metric_name = 'entry_stopper_lowering_time'
),
rolling AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    AVG(value)         OVER w AS rolling_mean,
    STDDEV_SAMP(value) OVER w AS rolling_std
  FROM base
  WINDOW w AS (
    ORDER BY time
    RANGE BETWEEN ${rolling_window:sqlstring}::interval PRECEDING
    AND CURRENT ROW
  )
)
SELECT
  time,
  rolling_mean,
  rolling_mean + 3 * rolling_std AS bb_upper,
  rolling_mean - 3 * rolling_std AS bb_lower
FROM rolling
ORDER BY time;
